name: ShelfTabs – Product Tabs for WooCommerce
author: morpheous7

sections.description:
Give shoppers the answers they look for before they buy, on any kind of product: Shipping & Returns, Warranty, FAQ, Specifications, What’s in the Box, Ingredients, Care instructions, Size Guide and more. Pick a ready-made pack for your kind of store and your tabs are ready in one click.

  • Custom tabs: add, edit, reorder and remove tabs on the Edit Product screen.
  • Saved tabs: write a tab once and add it to as many products as you like. Edit it once and every product updates.
  • Ready-made packs for 10 kinds of store: any store, electronics, home & furniture, beauty, food & drink, handmade, digital downloads, pet supplies, toys & baby, and clothing. Each adds three saved tabs with starter text in one click; just fill in your details.
  • Clean product pages: your tabs show after the standard tabs, and Reviews stays last.
  • One-click import from Custom Product Tabs for WooCommerce, including its saved tabs (kept linked, not copied). Its data is only read, never changed, and the import can be run again without creating duplicates.

Need a tab on every product in a category without adding it by hand? ShelfTabs Pro is an optional paid add-on that shows saved tabs automatically by category or tag, and fills in each product’s SKU, weight and attributes with merge tags. Everything listed above is free and stays free.

ShelfTabs is part of Shelf for WooCommerce: small plugins that answer what shoppers ask before they buy. Its sister plugin, ShelfDate, shows an estimated delivery date on product pages, and both Pro add-ons are available together as a cheaper bundle.
sections.faq:
How do I add a Shipping & Returns tab to every product?

Go to WooCommerce → ShelfTabs and add the “Any store” pack. Edit the Shipping & Returns tab once, then add it to your products from Product data → Product tabs. With ShelfTabs Pro, one rule shows it on every product, or on every product in chosen categories or tags, automatically.

How do I add a warranty tab in WooCommerce?

Add the “Any store” or “Electronics & gadgets” pack under WooCommerce → ShelfTabs. Both include a Warranty tab with starter text you can edit.

Which kinds of store have ready-made packs?

Any store, electronics & gadgets, home & furniture, beauty & personal care, food, drink & supplements, handmade & crafts, digital downloads, pet supplies, toys, kids & baby, and clothing & shoes.

Will ShelfTabs slow my store down?

No. On a product page, ShelfTabs adds no CSS or JavaScript files and no database queries of its own. Tabs use WooCommerce’s own tab system.

How do I add a size chart to my products?

Create a saved tab called “Size Guide” under WooCommerce > ShelfTabs and put your size chart in it (tables work). Then add it to each product from Product data > Product tabs. Edit the saved tab once and every product updates.

How do I add a saved tab to a product?

Create it under WooCommerce > ShelfTabs. Then edit a product, open Product data > Product tabs, pick the saved tab from the list and click Add saved tab.

How do I move from Custom Product Tabs for WooCommerce?

Go to WooCommerce > ShelfTabs and click Import now. Check a few product pages, then deactivate the old plugin.

Does the import change or delete my old tabs?

No. It only reads them. After an import, the old plugin’s tabs are hidden on product pages so nothing shows twice; you can turn that off in the settings.
sections.changelog:
0.3.6

  • Translations: Portuguese (Brazil) and Spanish (Spain and Mexico) are now included. WordPress.org language packs are used instead when they exist.

0.3.5

  • Faster: product pages make no extra database queries for ShelfTabs.
  • The ShelfTabs screen links straight to the form for writing your own tab, under the ready-made packs.

0.3.4

  • The import script now loads as a separate file on the ShelfTabs screen only.
  • The ShelfTabs screen mentions only the optional Pro add-on.

0.3.3

  • After 7 days of use, the ShelfTabs screen politely asks for a WordPress.org review. One click hides it for 30 days or for good.
  • Starter text in the packs tidied up.

0.3.2

  • Six new ready-made packs: home & furniture, beauty, handmade, digital downloads, pet supplies, and toys & baby. “Any store” is now first.

0.3.1

  • Links now point to the new ShelfTabs page. If ShelfDate is also installed, the settings page mentions the ShelfTabs + ShelfDate Pro bundle.

0.3.0

  • New: ready-made packs of saved tabs (Clothing & shoes, Any store, Electronics, Food & supplements), added in one click with starter text.
  • The welcome notice now points to the packs.
  • A one-line note about ShelfDate, our free delivery-date plugin, on the ShelfTabs screen (hidden when ShelfDate is installed).

0.2.2

  • New: a short welcome notice after activation that points to the ShelfTabs screen. Dismiss it once and it’s gone.
  • New: a one-line note about the optional ShelfTabs Pro add-on at the bottom of the ShelfTabs screen.
  • Readme: screenshots and a size chart FAQ.

0.2.1

  • Fix: video embeds and form shortcodes (contact forms, newsletter signups) now display inside tabs.

0.2.0

  • New: saved tabs, reused across products and edited in one place.
  • New: the import brings over the old plugin’s saved tabs and keeps them linked.
  • Renamed to ShelfTabs.

0.1.1

  • Fix: the “hide old tabs” setting now shows as on right after an import.

0.1.0

  • First version: per-product tabs and import from Custom Product Tabs for WooCommerce.
